rule: Until our estimated score in leaderboard crosses 209, don't submit our 1st submission.
estimate_basis: docs/PLAN.md decision log 2026-11-04 (c): our own committed evidence (backtests carried to the test boards, the oracle-base grids, the s2 hedge payoffs), each board at the better of its two uploads: T1 about 63, T3 about 65, heart about 52, embryo about 60; no test score, no leaderboard figure
estimate_first_round_note: the first round alone (T1 s1, heart s1, embryo s1 and T3's s2): roughly 160-170 on unreviewed arithmetic (docs/PLAN.md decision log 2026-11-05 (b)); experiments/gate/estimate.py is to compute it from committed files; until the captain says which reading he meant, an early crossing needs both readings above 209
deadline_exception: the captain, 2026-11-05, answering a side agent's note that the gate could mean no entry: "I am fine with submitting our 1st submission at Nov 27 anyway". The s1 methods freeze at 2026-11-27 00:00 UTC (05:30 IST); the files are rebuilt, checked and format-checked that morning; each upload still needs his go-ahead at the time
deadline_exception_source: the captain's own words, in his own message in the main session on 2026-11-05 (a note he wrote on a side agent's text he forwarded), not an agent's relay; the AI assistant asked him the same day to confirm or correct its reading: the gate's own scope (the first upload on every board: T1 s1, heart s1, embryo s1, T3's s2) from 2026-11-27 00:00 UTC (05:30 IST)
how_it_changes: docs/PLAN.md section 8: the AI assistant restates the estimate after every kept change; it passes early only above 209 with an independent reviewer's recomputation named in review; from deadline_exception_utc on it passes anyway (the captain's exception); only the captain sets lifted_by_captain, changes the threshold or moves the exception; the client's guard checks this record only, and the captain's go-ahead for each upload, which he runs himself, is the control beyond it
